## Source Documents
Page 44 has the CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF INCOME for Union Pacific Corporation and Subsidiary Companies. Dollar amounts are in millions. Page 45 has the CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF FINANCIAL POSITION for Union Pacific Corporation and Subsidiary Companies. Dollar amounts are in millions.

## Net Income
Net income for 2022 from page 44: $6,998 million.

## Total Assets
Total assets as of December 31, 2022 from page 45: $65,449 million.

## Return on Assets Calculation
Return on assets equals net income divided by total assets times 100. 6,998 divided by 65,449 times 100 equals 10.69%. Answer: 10.69%

## Formula
CapEx percent equals CapEx divided by cash flows from investing times 100.

## Cash Flows from Investing
Page 57 has the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows. The net cash used in investing activities for the fiscal year ending January 28, 2023 is $(111,454) thousand.

## CapEx Figure
The same table on page 57 shows "Purchases of property and equipment" at $(51,667) thousand.

## Calculation
51,667 divided by 111,454 times 100 equals 46.4%. Answer: 46.4%

## Balance Sheet Source
The "BACKBLAZE, INC. CONDENSED CONSOLIDATED BALANCE SHEETS (in thousands, except share and per share data)" on page 10 gives the following. "Accounts receivable, net" as of March 31, 2025 = $1,770 thousand. "Accounts receivable, net" as of December 31, 2024 = $1,831 thousand.

## Change in Accounts Receivable
Change = $1,770 thousand minus $1,831 thousand = negative $61 thousand. Accounts receivable decreased by $61 thousand.

## Revenue Source
The "BACKBLAZE, INC. CONDENSED CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF OPERATIONS AND COMPREHENSIVE LOSS (in thousands, except share and per share data)" on page 11 of Exhibit 99.1 gives "Revenue" for the three months ended March 31, 2025 = $34,613 thousand.

## Percentage Calculation
Percentage = (negative $61 divided by $34,613) times 100% = negative 0.1762%. Answer: negative 0.1762%

## Source
The Consolidated Statement of Income table is on page 95.

## New Revenue
Net sales for 2023 were $13,122 million. A 27% surge puts new revenue at 13,122 times 1.27. That is $16,664.94 million.

## New COGS
Cost of goods sold for 2023 was $8,839 million. Seasonal labor raises COGS by $800 million. New COGS is 8,839 plus 800 which is $9,639 million.

## Gross Profit
16,664.94 minus 9,639 is $7,025.94 million. Answer: $7,025.94 million

## Source
Note 2 on page 97 of the Owens Corning 2024 Form 10-K has a net sales table for the twelve months ended December 31, 2024.

## U.S. Insulation Residential Sales
The Insulation segment, U.S. residential line shows $1,578 million.

## U.S. Insulation Commercial and Industrial Sales
The Insulation segment, U.S. commercial and industrial line shows $809 million.

## Total U.S. Insulation Sales
$1,578 million plus $809 million is $2,387 million. The table confirms $2,387 million as the Total United States figure for the Insulation segment.

## Total Insulation Segment Sales
The Insulation segment total net sales is $3,692 million.

## Percentage Calculation
$2,387 divided by $3,692 is 0.64653. Times 100 that is 64.653%. Rounded, 64.65% of Insulation segment net sales came from the United States in the year ended December 31, 2024.

## Source
Page 86 has the Consolidated Statements of Operations. Amounts are in thousands.

## Revenue and Total Operating Expenses
For the year ended December 31, 2022: Revenue is $1,905,871 thousand. Total operating expenses are $1,658,523 thousand.

## Stock-Based Compensation Expense
Page 109 has the Stock-based Compensation Expense table. Total stock-based compensation expense within operating expenses for 2022 is $520,737 thousand.

## Adjusted Operating Expenses
Operating expenses excluding stock-based compensation: 1,658,523 minus 520,737 is 1,137,786 thousand. The individual line items from page 86 are sales and marketing of $702,511 thousand, research and development of $359,679 thousand, and general and administrative of $596,333 thousand. Those sum to $1,658,523 thousand before the stock-based compensation subtraction.

## Percentage Calculation
1,137,786 divided by 1,905,871 times 100 is 59.6990039%. Answer: 59.6990039%

## Source
The Management's Discussion and Analysis section starts on page 47. That section has a table showing the reconciliation from Net Income to FFO and Adjusted FFO for common stockholders. Units in that table are in thousands.

## Adjusted FFO Values
From that table: Adjusted FFO attributable to common stockholders for 2023 is $196,513 thousand. For 2022 it is $184,628 thousand.

## Year-Over-Year Growth Rate
Year-over-year growth rate from 2022 to 2023: 196,513 minus 184,628 is 11,885. 11,885 divided by 184,628 is 0.0643726843. That is a 6.44% growth rate.

## 2024 Projection
To project 2024: 196,513 times 1.0643726843 is 209,163.0693098459 thousand. Rounded to the nearest thousand that is $209,163 thousand. Answer: 209,163 thousand

## Source
Page 50 of Devon Energy's 2024 10-K has the Consolidated Balance Sheets. It shows current assets and current liabilities as of December 31, 2024. Values are in millions of U.S. dollars.

## Balance Sheet Figures
The balance sheet shows "Total current assets" of $3,427 million and "Total current liabilities" of $3,309 million.

## Current Ratio Calculation
Current Ratio = Current Assets divided by Current Liabilities = $3,427 divided by $3,309 = 1.04.

## Result
Devon Energy's liquidity ratio for 2024 is 1.04. Answer: 1.04

## Source for Upstream Pre-Tax Earnings
The Chevron 2004 Annual Report (for fiscal year 2003) contains Table III, titled "Results of Operations for Oil and Gas Producing Activities," as part of the supplemental oil and gas information. This table appears on physical page 58 of the PDF. The table header states that results are presented in millions of dollars.

## Worldwide Upstream Pre-Tax Earnings
Table III for the year ended December 31, 2003 shows the following line items for worldwide operations (including both consolidated companies and affiliated companies): Total revenues from net production of $22,535 million, production expenses and other deductions, and "Results before income taxes" of $12,475 million in the "Worldwide" column. This $12,475 million is the worldwide upstream pre-tax earnings for 2003.

## Net Oil-Equivalent Production
The net oil-equivalent production figure for 2003 appears in the production table on physical page 5 of the PDF. The row labeled "Total Including Affiliates" shows oil-equivalent production of 2,523 thousands of barrels per day (MBOED) for 2003.

## Annual Barrels Produced
To compute total annual barrels produced, multiply 2,523 MBOED by 1,000 (to convert to barrels per day) and by 365 days. This gives 2,523 times 1,000 times 365, which equals 920,895,000 barrels for the year.

## Pre-Tax Earnings per Barrel
The average upstream pre-tax earnings per barrel is $12,475 million divided by 920.895 million barrels. This equals $13.55 per barrel. Answer: $13.55 per barrel

## Source
Page 78 of Intel's 10-K has the balance sheet for Dec 30, 2023. Numbers are in millions.

## Reported Balance Sheet Figures
Current assets were $43,269. Current liabilities were $28,053. Accounts payable was $8,578 in 2023 and $9,595 in 2022.

## Accounts Payable Adjustment
The 2022 accounts payable times 1.10 is $10,554.5. That is $1,976.5 more than the reported 2023 figure of $8,578. So $1,976.5 gets added to current liabilities.

## Adjusted Current Assets
Subtract $1,100 from current assets: $43,269 minus $1,100 is $42,169.

## Adjusted Current Liabilities
Subtract $950 from current liabilities, then add $1,976.5: $28,053 minus $950 plus $1,976.5 is $29,079.5.

## Current Ratio Result
Divide $42,169 by $29,079.5: the result is 1.45. Answer: 1.45

## Source
The "Comparison of Five-Year Cumulative Total Return" chart appears on Document page 21 of the Sturm, Ruger & Company, Inc. 2023 10-K. A table in that chart has data for Sturm, Ruger & Company, Inc. and the S&P 500 and Russell 2000 Index from 2018 to 2023.

## Sturm Ruger
In 2021, Sturm, Ruger & Company, Inc. had a value of $147.45. In 2023, that value was $114.49. The change is $114.49 minus $147.45 which equals negative $32.96. Negative $32.96 divided by $147.45 equals negative 0.2235. That is negative 22.35%.

## Russell 2000
In 2021, the Russell 2000 Index had a value of $172.90. In 2023, that value was $160.85. The change is $160.85 minus $172.90 which equals negative $12.05. Negative $12.05 divided by $172.90 equals negative 0.0697. That is negative 6.97%.

## Percentage Difference
Negative 22.35% minus negative 6.97% equals negative 15.38 percentage points. The percentage difference in cumulative total return between Sturm, Ruger & Company, Inc. and the Russell 2000 Index from 2021 to 2023 is negative 15.38 percentage points.

## Source
The KINIKSA PHARMACEUTICALS INTERNATIONAL, PLC CONSOLIDATED BALANCE SHEETS is on page 143. It shows data for December 31, 2023 and December 31, 2022.

## Total Current Assets
Total current assets, December 31, 2023: $276,297.

## Total Current Liabilities
Total current liabilities, December 31, 2023: $63,666.

## Current Ratio Calculation
276,297 divided by 63,666 equals 4.3397888983. Answer: 4.3397888983

## Source
Page 64 of Oracle's 10-K has the Consolidated Statements of Operations. Values in that table are in millions.

## Operating Income
Operating Income for fiscal year 2024 is $15,353 million.

## Interest Expense
Page 66 of the same document also shows the Consolidated Statements of Operations. Interest Expense for fiscal year 2024 is $3,514 million. Values are in millions for the period ending May 31, 2024.

## Interest Coverage Ratio
15,353 divided by 3,514 equals 4.37. The Interest Coverage Ratio is 4.37. Answer: 4.37

## Source
Page 63 of the Bill 2024 10-K has the cumulative return graph in Item 5. It starts at $100 on December 12, 2019.

## Values
At June 30, 2024, Bill shows $150. The S&P 500 Index shows $170.

## Difference
$150 minus $170 is negative $20.

## Underperformance Calculation
Negative $20 divided by $170 is negative 0.1176. Times 100 that is negative 11.76%. Bill underperformed the S&P 500 Index by 11.76% from December 12, 2019 to June 30, 2024.

## Source
The CONSOLIDATED BALANCE SHEETS table starts on page 51.

## Current Assets by Year
2024 total current assets: $189,651,000.
2023 total current assets: $139,482,000.

## Current Liabilities by Year
2024 total current liabilities: $91,343,000.
2023 total current liabilities: $49,344,000.

## Current Ratio Change
2024 current ratio: 189,651 divided by 91,343 = 2.08. 2023 current ratio: 139,482 divided by 49,344 = 2.83. Change: 2.08 minus 2.83 = negative 0.75.
